newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Pacific BBA to build U.S. auto plant.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Pacific BBA to build U.S. auto plant.

text.p: Diversified manufacturer Pacific BBA Ltd said on Monday it planned to invest A$100 million to build an automotive parts manufacturing facility in the United States.

The plant would fill orders that form an A$200 million contract won earlier this month for the supply of disc brake calipers to several North American vehicle manufacturers, the company said in a statement.
Pacific BBA said it also was seeking U.S. partners to take a 49 percent equity stake in the facility.
Construction of the plant would commence in 1996 with completion expected in 1998, the year production commences, the company said.
Pacific BBA's share of the investment would be funded from internal cash flow and borrowings, it said.
The new facility would not diminish the importance of the Melbourne manufacturing site as the centrepiece of the company's automotive division, the company said.
At 0030 GMT (10.30 a.m.), Pacific BBA shares were unchanged at A$4.20.
